Initial release of "dispel-system" for relationship analysis.

- Provides a system to analyze and reveal hidden control structures in any relationship using first principles.
- Includes a structured inquiry protocol to guide users step-by-step, with strict safety and boundary checks before any analysis.
- Features three analysis output modes (Mirror / X-Ray / Wake-Up).
- Offers five companion models: Self-Deceiving Controller, Cycle Originator, Weaponized Virtue, System Collaborator, and Control Conduit.
- Prioritizes user safety, privacy, and autonomy throughout the process.
